span.label: accountability, privacy and fairness appear in about 80% of the guidelines, and the author's observation is that these are exactly the aspects for which technical fixes exist or are being built. A NORMATIVE VOCABULARY SELECTED BY TRACTABILITY: what can be engineered gets written down, and what cannot - political abuse, ecological cost, democratic erosion - does not
